podcast.title: Bulgari x Steve Aoki Clubbing Watch
podcast.body: DJ Steve Aoki collaborated with luxury jewelry manufacturer Bulgari to design a specialized watch intended for clubbing. This high-end timepiece, priced at $5,200, features a glow-in-the-dark function, effectively eliminating the need for traditional glow sticks. "DJ Steve Aoki got together with luxury jewelry maker Bulgari to create a watch just for clubbing."
